Thank you once again for your valuable feedback, and we hope to have the opportunity to serve you better in the future.

The Cut Collective Team

However it so happens that once a client walks in late, it pushes all our other appointments as well and we now keep a window for sanitatization after every client as well, so the entire schedule gets hit by this dominos effect!
Hope you understand. We are glad that you liked the haircut and we are definitely looking forward to welcoming you again at the salon.
